messages:
maya: Hey team, first week here — I followed the onboarding doc but I still can't access a bunch of dashboards in Grafana and Datadog. Grafana gives a 403 on /d/infra/overview and Datadog's UI says "You don't have permission to view this resource". Sentry shows 'Invite required'. Any quick pointers? cc @devex

/devex-bot: Welcome Maya! I created ticket OBS-5912 and notified the infra oncall. For faster resolution, paste your Okta email and the teams you need access to in this thread.

samir: Welcome! We gate observability via Okta groups. The access form is at https://access.redwood.com/request (choose Observability -> Monitoring). Group names: grafana-readers, datadog-viewers, sentry-developers. If you already submitted, please post the Okta email so we can locate the request.

maya: I submitted with maya@redwood.com. Request status shows pending approval. I tried the curl output for Grafana: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"message":"You don't have permission to view this dashboard"}
```

olivia: I can help. I approved the Okta request and added you to grafana-readers. There can be a 1-2 minute sync delay. Try logging out and back in to Grafana (clears session). For Datadog, you need the Viewer role scoped to the infra org — I just invited you to the org. For Sentry, the invite email was sent to your Okta address; check spam.

maya: Logged out/in on Grafana and it's loading now, thanks. However the infra/overview dashboard panels render but some panels say "No data" and the time range is defaulting to 7d. Is there a recommended time range and datasource?

samir: For troubleshooting use the 1h or 6h range. Also confirm the datasource is set to metrics-prod or metrics-readonly. Non-admin accounts may default to a read-only datasource that doesn't have long retention. If you want persistent defaults changed for everyone, open a PR in infra/grafana-dashboards with updated templating defaults.

maya: How do I run queries against prod without firing alerts? I just want to test panel queries.

olivia: We have a sandbox metrics datasource called metrics-sandbox. When editing a panel, change the datasource dropdown to metrics-sandbox. You can also prefix queries in advanced mode. If you need to run a one-off prod query for verification, DM me and I can create a short-lived token scoped to read-only queries.

maya: Great, that works. Last Q: who reviews dashboard PRs and how long do deploys take? I don't want to break anything in infra dashboards.

samir: Eng-sre reviews infra dashboards PRs. Typical turnaround is <24h for small changes. Deploys run via the dashboards CI and take ~5-10 minutes once merged. For major changes, open a draft PR and request a review from @eng-sre.

maya: Thanks everyone — this made the first-day setup way smoother :party_parrot:

/devex-bot: Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/observability (checklist: Okta groups, datasource list, PR process). Closing OBS-5912 as resolved; reopen if still blocked.
